subject: Vendor roster amendment — please confirm cross-border transfer paths
messages:
From: Meera Iyer <meera.iyer@halcyon-payments.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor roster amendment: new telemetry partner (EdgeRelay)

Hi Sergio,

Quick heads-up — Halcyon is adding a telemetry/ingestion partner (EdgeRelay) to our telemetry pipeline beginning July 8. They will receive limited logs and metadata for operational monitoring and metrics. Attached is the updated vendor roster (vendor-roster-v3.xlsx) and a small dataflow diagram (dataflow-diagram.png) showing where EdgeRelay sits.

High-level:
- Purpose: telemetry ingestion, sampling, and delivery to analytics.
- Data types: service logs (non-sensitive), aggregated usage metrics, IP + timestamp for routing. No PII is expected to be sent.
- Residency: primary processing nodes in eu-west-1 (EU) and us-west-2 (US).
- Downstream: EdgeRelay batches and forwards aggregated metrics to our analytics storage in us-east1 (GCP).

Action items for Redwood: please confirm whether this addition requires a DPA addendum or a simple notification under our existing DPA. Also confirm if you need a transfer-path map or any onshore fallback guarantees for EU data. We want to get this on your radar early.

Files attached: vendor-roster-v3.xlsx, dataflow-diagram.png

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Meera Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager, Halcyon Payments
meera.iyer@halcyon-payments.com
+1 415 555 0198

Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor roster amendment: new telemetry partner (EdgeRelay)

Meera — thanks for the update and the attachments.

A few clarifying questions from our side so we can route this to Legal and Security properly:
1) Can you confirm whether any customer-level identifiers (user IDs, account IDs, email hashes) will be included in the telemetry payloads sent to EdgeRelay? You indicated "non-sensitive" but we need explicit confirmation.
2) Does EdgeRelay host their processing in dedicated subnets/tenants for Halcyon or is this multi-tenant?
3) Is EdgeRelay using vendor-managed KMS or customer-managed keys (HSM)? If the former, do they publish their key regions and rotation policy?
4) For EU-origin traffic, do you have an onshore fallback (on-prem or EU-only vendor) in the event of an export control / egress suspension? If not, we need to understand SLA/residency risk.

From our side we'll:
- Ask Legal to review the roster and confirm whether an addendum is required.
- Ask Security for a quick evidence request (SOC2 type statements + network zones).

If it's easier, suggest we run a 30-min sync early next week with Kimberly and Naomi.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 206 555 0144

---
(Internal note: flagged for Legal + Sec review: INF-2345)

From: Meera Iyer <meera.iyer@halcyon-payments.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeRelay Support <support@edgerelay.io>
Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor roster amendment: new telemetry partner (EdgeRelay)

Thanks Sergio — answers below inline.

1) Customer identifiers: EdgeRelay will receive only hashed session identifiers (sha256) and routing tokens; no raw emails or plain customer IDs. We do send a merchant_account_id (internal numeric id) for routing.

2) Tenancy: EdgeRelay will run Halcyon workloads in a logically separated tenant with dedicated ingress endpoints (single tenant per customer). They do not mix data between customers.

3) KMS: EdgeRelay uses vendor-managed KMS by default. They do offer a dedicated HSM/key-import option as an add-on for enterprise customers — it's not enabled by default. Rotation policy: 90 days, keys located in the region where processing occurs (eu-west-1, us-west-2).

4) Onshore fallback: Halcyon does not currently have a permanent EU-only fallback for telemetry; EdgeRelay can offer a temporary onshore spool (30-day window) at request and cost, but not a fully provisioned fallover.

I've attached EdgeRelay's processor scope PDF (edge-relay-processor-scope.pdf) and a DocuSign link for a minimal DPA addendum that Halcyon proposes. The addendum is limited to telemetry ingestion and excludes analytics exports — we can mark exports as "analytics delivery only" in the addendum if that helps.

DocuSign (proposed addendum): https://docusign.com/AAABBB-12345
EdgeRelay scope: attached

If Kimberly/legal want sample SOC2 pages, EdgeRelay can provide a redacted evidence packet.

Best,
Meera

Subject: Next steps: DPA addendum and evidence request (EdgeRelay)

Meera / Sergio — looping in Legal & Privacy for the routing items. Thanks for the clear answers — that helps. We need the following from Halcyon / EdgeRelay before we can approve the roster amendment in our vendor registry: 

Action items (recommended timeline 7 business days):
- DocuSign: push the proposed DPA addendum to a "review" copy so our counsel can comment (link you provided is fine; please set reviewers to kimberly.park@redwood.com and lauren.bishop@redwood.com).
- Evidence: redacted SOC2 summary (or ISO27001 cert) + network zone diagram showing the dedicated tenant boundary.
- Dataflow map: confirm the exact fields sent to EdgeRelay (sample schema or sample payload with sensitive fields redacted).
- KMS option: confirm whether HSM is available and pricing for permanent EU-only HSM option (we'll evaluate given European residency concerns).
- Fallback: confirm the short-term onshore spool SLA and expected RTO/RPO if invoked.

If we receive these items we can generally approve the addition as a limited telemetry processor under our DPA with a short addendum to confirm residency/export controls. If the HSM/permanent EU residency is required by Halcyon, we may need a stronger addendum and potentially an escrow/onshore clause.

Please aim to get the DocuSign review copy and SOC2 redacted pages by EOD next Wednesday (10 Jul). If that timeline is tight, propose alternatives.

Thanks — Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
